codeReview.summary: The feature removes the targeted `catch (...: any)` sites and the repository no longer contains any `catch (...: any)` matches in extension or test TypeScript sources. Most replacements preserve existing fallback behavior with `unknown` catches plus local narrowing helpers, but one test-only error path now references a helper from inside a `worker.evaluate` callback where that helper is not available.

issues.description: The `worker.evaluate(async () => { ... })` callback runs in the browser worker context, so it cannot access the outer Node-side `getErrorMessage` helper. If the `try` block throws, the `catch` path will raise `ReferenceError: getErrorMessage is not defined` instead of returning the intended structured error payload.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `refactor-worker` procedure still makes repo-standards/file-size validation look unconditional even though this mission already documents unrelated baseline repo-standards failures. Workers are forced to mark `followedProcedure` false and explain the exception by hand when their own diff is compliant.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Mission `AGENTS.md` says `npm run check:repo-standards` has known unrelated failures, `.factory/skills/refactor-worker/SKILL.md` only permits proceeding after a separately documented scoped fallback, and handoff `2026-03-28T10-05-40-645Z__fix-catch-any-patterns__5ac35cee-3af0-4336-8446-ba5fa8529d66.json` records `skillFeedback.followedProcedure: false` for exactly that reason.
